s1.quote: Depth: 17 – 42 metres … Visibility: 30 metres … Qualification Required: Advance Open Water (AOW) … She now lies on her port side on a flat bed of sand and rocks.

s2.quote: Due to its size and variations of depths (150ft to 50ft side to side) … the visibility is usually between 50+ to 100+ ft. … with some lorries scattered at the bottom where they came to rest

highlights.text: Wreck lying on its port side

summary.text: A large ro-ro ferry that capsized off Larnaca and rests on her port side on sand. The upper side starts around 17 m and the lowest decks reach about 42 m, with penetration options; a classic Mediterranean wreck dive.

s1.quote: sits in approximately 24.3 metres (80 ft) of water … a vessel is required to complete the transit to the site
